scope: Open development; 12 underlying worlds reused across expression families, delays and swaps. Not an independent final assessment or broad capability claim.

budget.decision: Improve joint prose/Rust read selection on the same artifact, preserving old modes and prose baseline; diagnose actual generated code with compiler feedback.

static_candidate_audit.method: Read-only reconstruction of ASCII codec pieces and retained cue/posting addresses from preserved artifacts and prompts. No model score, generated token, training, or new model evaluation was run. Token counts, expected token position and memory candidate counts were checked against every saved case.
findings: Target is admitted by memory in all192 cases of both artifacts. Final shortlist coverage alone was insufficient to establish that fact.
128 visits equals8 query tokens x4 source offsets x4 postings, so traversal order cannot expand current-case reachability.
Rust punctuation-source postings can be overwritten by filler, but surviving quote routes still admit the answer.
Word cues add an identifier-specific route without fixing the Rust scoring/fit problem.

assertion_execution.scope: Link and execute the 96 unchanged generated Rust assertion programs after inspecting their finite assignment/assertion source. No code repair, expected-value insertion, or training feedback.

resources.budget_boundary: Soft wall checks between documents and development cases; finite readout fit, compile and reload may overrun. No automatic retries or additional runs.
